name: decision-table-creation
description: Express complex business rules as decision tables. Per rule: combination of condition values (Y/N/don't-care) mapping to actions. Supports limited-entry (boolean), extended-entry (value-based), and mixed tables. Detects inconsistency (contradictory rules), redundancy (duplicate coverage), and incompleteness (gaps in condition space). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
